titel: Bouw- en constructietekening: 50 m²; academic research review
omschrijving: I’m currently doing research on the experiences of self-employed construction workers in the Netherlands, especially around late or missing payments. Have you ever had to wait a long time to get paid, or deal with clients who didn’t pay at all? I would really value hearing your story in a short (20–30 min) confidential interview. Completely anonymous No preparation needed Just an open conversation about your experience The goal is to better understand what’s really happening, so that more relevant support and solutions can be developed. If you’re open to sharing your experience, feel free to send me an email. [Inhoud verwijderd]
